title: Comfort Club Reinstatement Fee: Amount Charged
content:
Member accounts schedule for the fee charged on reinstating a lapsed Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement.

**Tiers without a fee.** On a tier whose reinstatement fee is 0.00, no reinstatement fee is charged.

**Other tiers.** The reinstatement fee is worked out at the moment of reinstatement from the records of the lapsed term, as follows.

- The **lapse days** are the calendar days from the lapsed term's last day to the date of handling.
- The **reinstatement fee** is the lapse-adjusted fee multiplied by the tenure share, plus the forfeit surcharge, less the installation courtesy and the protection courtesy, rounded to the cent half up and never below zero. A fee of 0.00 posts no fee entry.
- The **lapse-adjusted fee** is the tier's reinstatement fee as it stands.
- The **tenure share** is one (1.0).
- The **forfeit surcharge**, the **installation courtesy** and the **protection courtesy** are zero.

## Order of working
1. Start from the lapse-adjusted fee.
2. Multiply it by the tenure share.
3. Add the forfeit surcharge.
4. Take off the installation courtesy and the protection courtesy.
5. Round to the cent half up; if the result is below zero, the fee is 0.00.

## Worked example (hypothetical Comfort Club Silver agreement)
Term ended 31 May 2025; date of handling 20 June 2025, so 20 lapse days. The tier's reinstatement fee is 25.00.

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Lapse-adjusted fee | 25.00 |
| Multiplied by the tenure share of one | 25.00 |
| Forfeit surcharge | 0.00 |
| Installation and protection courtesy | 0.00 |
| Reinstatement fee | 25.00 |

The same reinstatement on Comfort Club Platinum, whose reinstatement fee is 0.00, charges no fee and posts no fee entry.
